#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

inline ll myabs(ll a) { return a < 0 ? -a : a; }

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    ll g = gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;
    if (y <= n) {
        cout << x << '/' << y << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll bestNum = 1000000000;
    ll bestDen = 1;
    ll i = 1;
    while (i <= n) {
        ll cur = (x * i) / y;
        if (bestDen * myabs(x * i - cur * y) < i * myabs(x * bestDen - bestNum * y)) {
            bestDen = i;
            bestNum = cur;
        }
        cur++;
        if (bestDen * myabs(x * i - cur * y) < i * myabs(x * bestDen - bestNum * y)) {
            bestDen = i;
            bestNum = cur;
        }
        i++;
    }
    cout << bestNum << '/' << bestDen << endl;
    return 0;
}

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

inline ll myabs(ll a) { return a < 0 ? -a : a; }

bool isBetter(ll num, ll den, ll bestNum, ll bestDen, ll x, ll y) {

}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

inline ll myabs(ll a) { return a < 0 ? -a : a; }

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    ll g = gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;
    if (y <= n) {
        cout << x << '/' << y << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> candidates;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        ll cur = (x * i) / y;
        ll diff1 = myabs(x * i - cur * y);
        ll diff2 = myabs(x * i - (cur+1) * y);
        if (diff1 <= diff2)
            candidates.push_back({cur, i});
        else
            candidates.push_back({cur+1, i});
    }
    auto best = min_element(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(),
        [&](const pair<ll,ll>& a, const pair<ll,ll>& b) {
            return b.second * myabs(x * a.second - a.first * y) < a.second * myabs(x * b.second - b.first * y);
        }
    );
    cout << best->first << '/' << best->second << endl;
    return 0;
}
